Name: Ace's Evelyn for Seasonal Cute
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I love acerbicon's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/933]Evelyn mod[/url] but I also love Poltergeister's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetics[/url], so I thought, por que no los dos? So I present a fresh new seasonal Evelyn!

Credits go to acerbicon for Evelyn's portrait. Credits for the seasonal outfits go to Poltergeister, ﻿Airyn, and Alvadea. All artists either already had open permissions or directly gave me permission to use their assets :)

This mod is meant to be used with Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic. Simply overwrite the portraits and character sheets ﻿with the included files
